description: Comprehensive collection of classes for creating, configuring, and managing toolpaths programmatically. These classes are used with ToolpathManager to create various types of toolpaths (profiling, pocketing, drilling, V-carving, etc.)
note: Due to the extensive number of properties and constants in these classes, this documentation includes the most commonly used members. Refer to the Vectric Lua API manual for complete details on all properties and enum values.

classes.name: Tool
classes.documentation: Represents a cutting tool with all parameters (diameter, speeds, feeds, etc.). Can be created programmatically for common tool types or retrieved from ToolDatabase for all tool types.

classes.name: GeometrySelector
classes.documentation: Specifies automatic geometry selection criteria for toolpath creation. Default constructor leaves selector inactive (uses currently selected vectors). Set properties to enable automatic selection by layer, vector type, circle diameter, etc.

constructors.label: GeometrySelector()
constructors.documentation: Creates a new GeometrySelector with default values (inactive - uses current selection)

properties.name: AllowOpen
properties.documentation: If true, selector will allow open vectors in selection

properties.name: AllowToolDia
properties.documentation: If true, selector will use ToolDia field when selecting vectors

properties.name: CircleDia
properties.documentation: Diameter of circles to select if CircleMatchCircleDia and SelectCircles are true

properties.name: CircleTolerance
properties.documentation: Tolerance when deciding if circle matches ToolDia/CircleDia criteria

properties.name: CircleMatchAll
properties.documentation: If true, select all circles (if SelectCircles is true)

properties.name: CircleMatchCircleDia
properties.documentation: If true, select circles matching CircleDia (if SelectCircles is true)

properties.name: CircleMatchToolDia
properties.documentation: If true, select circles matching tool diameter (if SelectCircles is true)

properties.name: GeometryDepthOffset
properties.documentation: Offset value to add to geometry depth

properties.name: GeometryDepthOffsetFormula
properties.documentation: Formula for depth offset from geometry

properties.name: MixedGroupsOk
properties.documentation: If true, groups which only match some criteria are selected

properties.name: OnlyOnLayers
properties.documentation: If true, only vectors on layers added with AddLayerName are selected

properties.name: SelectClosed
properties.documentation: If true, closed vectors are selected

properties.name: SelectCircles
properties.documentation: If true, only selecting circles

properties.documentation: If true, open vectors are selected

properties.name: SetDepthFromGeometry
properties.documentation: If true, depth for toolpath is set from selected geometry (from DXF with depth)

properties.name: ToolDia
properties.documentation: Diameter of circles to select if CircleMatchToolDia and SelectCircles are true

properties.name: HaveLayerNames
properties.documentation: True if geometry selector has a list of layer names

properties.name: LayerNameCount
properties.documentation: Number of layers in list
